estimands.unit: one configuration = one capture file (head pair x prompt seed); counts are numbers of configurations with p < 0.05, medians are over configurations within a group
estimands.wald_p_S / wald_p_J: p of the joint Wald test H0: c = 0 (3 cross coefficients ab, a^2b, ab^2 of the cubic working model, FWL fit, iid-error covariance), chi2_3; single-site rows Zs,Ys (448) / support-matched joint rows Zjm,Yjm (256); chart = centring/scaling on all S+J rows, as in identifiability.analyse
estimands.cons_p: p of H0: c_S = c_J, statistic (c_S-c_J)'(V_S+V_J)^{-1}(c_S-c_J) ~ chi2_3, same chart
estimands.lam_max_VSinv_VJ: largest eigenvalue of V_S^{-1} V_J; << 1 means the consistency test is driven almost entirely by V_S
estimands.power_J_at_cS: power of the 5% joint Wald test if the true c were c_S: noncentral chi2_3 with ncp = c_S' V_J^{-1} c_S
estimands.VJ_inflation_for_50pct_power: ncp_J_at_cS / ncp giving 50% power: the factor by which V_J would have to be understated for J to miss c = c_S half the time
estimands.resid_var_armA_over_armB: variance of full-cubic single-site residuals on arm A (source head patched, where the cross block is identified) over arm B (target head patched, a pinned); fit() pools one s2 over both
estimands.lof_{S,J}_p: Chow predictive-failure F test of the cubic working model, trained on donor half 0 (chart + 10 coefficients fit there only), tested on donor half 1; S: 224/224 rows by donor parity; J: 64/64 rows, both donors in the same half
estimands.lof_{S,J}_ratio: mean squared held-out prediction error / training residual variance (RSS/(n-p)); ratio_null = its expectation under the working model, 1 + mean held-out leverage
estimands.lof_*_reverse / _rowsplit: same test with halves swapped / with a random half of rows (rows of one donor in both halves)
estimands.gain_{S,J}_test: 1 - MSE_test(full cubic)/MSE_test(additive cubic), both trained on donor half 0: held-out value of the cross block; gain_train is its in-sample analogue 1 - RSS_full/RSS_add on the training half
estimands.rep_{S,J}_p: split-half replication: c fit separately on the two donor halves, (c1-c2)'(V1+V2)^{-1}(c1-c2) ~ chi2_3
estimands.wald_p_{S,J}_add5: joint Wald p for the same 3 cross coefficients with the additive block enlarged to degree 5 (adds a^4,a^5,b^4,b^5)
estimands.wald_p_{S,J}_deg5: joint Wald p, chi2_10, that ALL 10 cross coefficients a^i b^j (i,j>=1, i+j<=5) are zero, degree-5 additive block: non-additivity of higher order than the cubic working model can express
estimands.dependence: configurations are not independent units: for a given (target head, seed) the prompt, donors, and all arm-B single-site rows are bit-identical across the 4 source heads, and in the control group the joint readouts are ~identical too
estimands.info_min_C: smallest eigenvalue of the cross-block partial information on the clamped single-site rows Zc (why the clamped family is not analysed)
